_comment: Render sweep on the jscad modeling engine (sci push jscadui/render-jscad), 320s hang guard, all 1420 models the manifold sweep covers (807 before 2026-09-27). 1175 render and 75 only echo. geom2 booleans run on clipper-lib (modeling ff759668), which fixed all 25 models whose extruded geom2 did not close. 195 of the 245 failures are also manifold failures; 50 are jscad-only: 22 scale() calls with a zero or negative factor (all of yapp-box, threads.scad, openscad-tests), 3 circles with fewer than three segments, and the empties and one-offs in docs/backlog.md. PCB.scad now renders; radials.scad now reaches its 3D unions and crashes the renderer instead of erroring early. packing_circles.scad and heart_chain.scad sit on the 290s model budget and are marked flaky.
tree: main working tree, rsynced onto the CI base worktree by sci — no commit identifies the code that was measured
